catalogue.R0: Exact frozen late_limits010, detector observations have no financial effect
catalogue.R1: R0 plus block every new Core and filler entry while risk-off
catalogue.R2: R1 plus full regular managed-position exits at next executable open; retain failed obligations
catalogue.R3: R2 plus immediate BTC24H stress trigger
catalogue.R4: R2 plus exactly one recovery-close fresh entry window for then-flat UP Core candidates; original signals take priority and unchanged policy gates apply

recovery_R4_only.trigger: Only the exact finalized close that changes R2 risk-off to recovered
recovery_R4_only.eligible: Flat Core symbols in UP, current close strictly above upper band, no original real signal, valid point and all unchanged original CMO/slope/profile/risk/exchange/budget/liquidity gates
recovery_R4_only.one_shot: Fresh deterministic RECOVERY_ENTER|R4|symbol|close ID; consume window even when blocked; never replay
recovery_R4_only.gate_history: Clone already-updated original gate, remove only current appended VIDYA, call unchanged decide on synthetic flip-up; assert resulting history equals original and never mutate original gate
recovery_R4_only.priority: Original real signals override recovery synthesis for same coin; Core/filler handoff and ranking unchanged
recovery_R4_only.ranking_strength: Strictly positive (current finalized close - current upper band)/current ATR; original descending strength and symbol tie-break
recovery_R4_only.outstanding_exit: If any regime obligation is unresolved at recovery close, consume window without emitting recovery entries

causality.input: Finalized aligned hourly Core IndicatorPoints and BTC close history only
causality.return_denominator: Finalized BTC close exactly 120/24 hours before current finalized close
causality.execution: After decision close, at next executable open; never backdate
causality.forced_exit_priority: Original regular exits before appended regime exits; one pending exit per owned symbol; all exit attempts before growth reductions and entries
causality.retry: Original failed exit signal persists until owned position closes, including after regime recovery

cases.rules: Exact fresh26Oct exchange filters from old frozen crosscheck contract

r0_acceptance: All14 control cases reproduce stored late010 fills, trades, signals, every hourly cash/equity/position-value, all metrics and data hashes exactly; explicit metadata projection only
limits: Same two overlapping known historical windows; not independent unseen validation
USDT proxy and26Oct filter assumptions retained; no invented prelisting history
Fictional quote volume assumed1M/hour except known event; not actual future orderbook liquidity
Old721k whipsaw outcome is an idealized sine artifact, never forecast or target
Guard can miss early losses, exit into gaps, churn, miss recovery, stay paused, and lose in every world
No guaranteed drawdown ceiling, profitability or unattended operational availability
No fictional-positive-return veto; preservation diagnostics do not authorize changing profit-first ranking
Old frozen NO_PROMOTION disposition stays unchanged
financial_execution_gate: Method.json plus Contract.json plus Root-Method-GO.json and A09-Method-GO.json, both approved and exact hashes; R1-R4 additionally need all14 R0 exact controls first
post_outcome_changes: Any mechanism, parameter, window, warmup, seed, cost, selection or technical gate change requires a separately named study; no repairs hidden under this contract
